title_as_printed: (no caption; text: values obtained for the water density of the carbon dioxide solutions over a range of temperatures)
property_description: Mass of water per unit volume of the CO2-saturated aqueous liquid (g H2O per cc solution) at the liquid fill-point of the pvt experiments; not the full solution density (CO2 mass excluded). pi = initial CO2 pressure (atm). Overall composition about 5 mol% CO2 (text).
pressure_note: pi = initial CO2 pressure charged into the dry vessel at T (atm); the pressure at the fill point is not printed.

P.what: initial CO2 pressure, not the equilibrium pressure

value2.what: pure (saturated) liquid water density at T

conversion_needs: Not a solution density: grams of water per cm3 of CO2 solution; the CO2 content at the fill point is not printed (overall ~5 mol% CO2).
notes: Authors: fill-point less precise with CO2 present than for salt solutions or water alone. Not mapped to rho_gas_loaded because the CO2 mass is not included.
